chunks: And the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) said to Abu Dharr in his will to him:
"O Abu Dharr, preserve the will of your Prophet: Whoever is marked out for standing in night prayer and then dies, for him is Paradise." In a long hadith.

key_terms.أَبُو ذَرٍّ: Abu Dharr, a companion of the Prophet
key_terms.قِيَامُ اللَّيْلِ: Night prayer / Standing in prayer at night

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for dying while practicing night prayer according to the Prophet's advice to Abu Dharr?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family) instructs Abu Dharr to guard the virtue of Qiyam al-Layl, emphasizing it as a distinguishing mark of the righteous. This specific promise of Paradise for those who die while steadfast in this night devotion highlights its status as a key spiritual discipline in Shia tradition for purifying the soul and drawing near to God.
